items.title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
items.summary: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.

items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
items.summary: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

items.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
items.summary: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
items.summary: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23.

items.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
items.summary: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECBs first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative.

items.title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in 'Impossible' Game
items.summary: Google's Willow quantum processor beat the classical ceiling in a four-qubit coordination game, revealing a promising hardware test rather than commercial quantum computing.

items.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
items.summary: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox Series X dump of GTA 6 and is demanding a $15 million crypto pump for a PC port.

items.title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
items.summary: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms to defraud users.

items.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight
items.summary: Signal is blocking screenshots in its latest beta to prevent AI models from training on private messages.

items.title: Palmer Luckey Says He's Building an Offshore Haven for Industry-And 'Illegal' Medicine
items.summary: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.

items.title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
items.summary: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue.

items.title: Trump to host second memecoin dinner tonight with TRUMP down 99% from peak
items.summary: Boxer Floyd Mayweather, Shark Tank investor Kevin O'Leary and NBA champion Tristan Thompson are scheduled to appear at the dinner.

items.title: CFTC Chair on Hyperliquid and onchain venues, Ripple CLO doubts Elizabeth Warren will set crypto policy, and more
items.summary: CFTC Chair Selig outlines how Hyperliquid and other onchain venues could enter the US.

items.title: Coinbase backs CFTC proposal to distinguish prediction market contracts from gambling
items.summary: Coinbase said event contracts already qualify as swaps under the CEA and that explicit inclusion would provide greater regulatory certainty.

items.title: XRP Ledger trial settled 213,000 paid AI requests in 6,324 transactions
items.summary: t54 Labs reported 0.36 drops per paid request in its October beta, and two November checks show a merchant receiving RLUSD.

items.title: Bitcoin's next big threat could come from two oil tankers in the Middle East
items.summary: Two reported tanker strikes put the recent Brent decline to the test as traders watch outbound cargo and US rate expectations.

items.title: Bitcoin's $60,000 breakdown puts December Fed decision under the spotlight
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000 on Friday for the first time since July, with US spot Bitcoin funds recording withdrawals.

items.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
items.summary: New letters show the widening range of Congressional committees that will be probing the presidential administration - and the crypto collateral that may be swept up.

items.title: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins
items.summary: Quantum computers can't break Bitcoin network's security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
items.summary: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

items.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
items.summary: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, pointing to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

items.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
items.summary: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

items.title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
items.summary: The sell-off hit Wagyu's XMR1 token, separate from Monero and Hyperliquid's XMR futures market.
